description: (Single) Dam Failures Analysis Output - I-GUIDE Aging Dam Project is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Kalyanam, Rajesh (deposited on HydroShare). This data repository is connected with a manuscript entitled "Socioeconomic characteristics of at-risk populations impacted by the aging dam infrastructure in the USA - Who is facing the risk of potential dam failures? Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2023-09-03 and last updated 2023-09-03; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the resource metadata. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
